MASTER-SAAO robotic telescope  [1]  located in South Africa (South African Astronomical Observatory) started inspect of the Fermi GRB 260805A ( Fermi GBM team, GCN 45286) errorbox  26848 sec after notice time and 26944 sec after trigger time at 2026-08-05 16:47:37 UT, with upper limit up to  18.3 mag. Observations started at twilight.  The observations began at zenith distance = 73 deg. The sun  altitude  is -10.3 deg. 

The galactic latitude b = 38 deg., longitude l = 61 deg.


Real time updated cover map and OT discovered available here: 
https://master.sai.msu.ru/site/master2/observ.php?id=3458691
